verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one deprecation instance. `codex mcp-server` is marked deprecated, pointing users to the Codex app server, and its docs are kept for existing integrations (codex-docs-23), while the MCP interface is labeled experimental (codex-gh-6). That shows some deprecation practice but no formal policy or versioning scheme; the OpenAPI spec (codex-gh-9) describes the general OpenAI REST API and says nothing about versions or deprecation. Missing for 10: explicit API versioning for Codex interfaces, a documented deprecation policy with timelines or support windows, independent corroboration.
